recoveryBuddyDid.description: did:* of the custodial party being enrolled. Source of truth: src/packages/devices/manifest-operations-part-2.ts, recovery_buddy.add inputSchema.

recoveryBuddyPublicKeyHex.description: The buddy's Ed25519 public key, 64 lowercase hex characters (32 bytes). Required by recovery_buddy.add; an enrolment without it names a party no later recovery event can verify.

name.description: Optional display label for the buddy, for audit and UI.
